Seen • Just now
Once an order has already shipped and been handed to the courier, changes such as updating the shipping address are generally no longer possible while the package is in transit. 
Address updates are only possible before the order leaves the warehouse. After shipping, the package continues to the delivery address on the order.

Refuse delivery when the courier arrives (if allowed), or
Accept the package and start a return after delivery.
